CREATE FUNCTION tenant_notification_schedule(route text, excluded uuid[], members integer, ordinal integer, horizon bigint) RETURNS TABLE (tenant_id uuid,deadline bigint) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path FROM CURRENT AS $schedule$
  SELECT d.tenant_id, d.deadline FROM (
    (SELECT r.tenant_id,r.next_at AS deadline FROM tenant_notification_requests r
     WHERE r.consumer=route AND r.next_at<=horizon AND state IN ('pending','uncertain') AND dedup_key LIKE 'realtime-cycle:%' AND NOT (r.tenant_id=ANY(excluded)) AND (members=1 OR mod((('x'||substr(encode(sha256(convert_to(r.tenant_id::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),1,16))::bit(64) # x'8000000000000000')::bigint::numeric + 9223372036854775808, members) = ordinal)
     ORDER BY r.next_at,r.tenant_id LIMIT 64)
    UNION ALL
    (SELECT r.tenant_id,r.attempt_until AS deadline FROM tenant_notification_requests r
     WHERE r.consumer=route AND r.attempt_until<=horizon AND state='attempting' AND attempt_until IS NOT NULL AND dedup_key LIKE 'realtime-cycle:%' AND NOT (r.tenant_id=ANY(excluded)) AND (members=1 OR mod((('x'||substr(encode(sha256(convert_to(r.tenant_id::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),1,16))::bit(64) # x'8000000000000000')::bigint::numeric + 9223372036854775808, members) = ordinal)
     ORDER BY r.attempt_until,r.tenant_id LIMIT 64)
    UNION ALL
    (SELECT p.tenant_id,(CASE WHEN producer @> '{"ackPending":true}'::jsonb THEN 0 ELSE (producer->>'repeatAt')::bigint END) AS deadline FROM tenant_notification_state p
     WHERE p.consumer=route AND (CASE WHEN producer @> '{"ackPending":true}'::jsonb THEN 0 ELSE (producer->>'repeatAt')::bigint END)<=horizon AND (producer @> '{"ackPending":true}'::jsonb OR jsonb_typeof(producer->'repeatAt')='number') AND NOT (p.tenant_id=ANY(excluded)) AND (members=1 OR mod((('x'||substr(encode(sha256(convert_to(p.tenant_id::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),1,16))::bit(64) # x'8000000000000000')::bigint::numeric + 9223372036854775808, members) = ordinal)
     ORDER BY (CASE WHEN producer @> '{"ackPending":true}'::jsonb THEN 0 ELSE (producer->>'repeatAt')::bigint END),p.tenant_id LIMIT 64)
  ) d ORDER BY d.deadline,d.tenant_id LIMIT 64
$schedule$
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION tenant_notification_schedule(text,uuid[],integer,integer,bigint) FROM PUBLIC

CREATE FUNCTION tenant_notification_mark_ack(subject uuid, route text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path FROM CURRENT AS $mark$
  UPDATE tenant_notification_state
    SET producer=jsonb_set(producer,'{ackPending}','true'::jsonb)
    WHERE subject=nullif(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id',true),'')::uuid
      AND tenant_id=subject AND consumer=route AND NOT (producer @> '{"ackPending":true}'::jsonb)
$mark$
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION tenant_notification_mark_ack(uuid,text) FROM PUBLIC
